description: This file defines the DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig class, which provides configuration settings for health checking, including enabling/disabling the check and setting the interval duration.

classes.name: DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig
classes.description: Represents the default implementation for health check configuration, providing 'enabled' status and 'interval' duration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultBasicHealthCheckConfig from a given Config object.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether health checking is enabled.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration for health checks.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path used for this config.
